# Hacker News

> > Tech news aggregator and discussion platform run by Y Combinator, featuring startup news, programming insights, and community-driven conversations.

Hacker News is a social news website focusing on computer science and entrepreneurship, known for its active community discussions on technology, startups, AI, programming languages like RISC-V, and influential figures like Tony Hoare and Yann LeCun. The platform serves as a central hub for tech enthusiasts, founders, and developers to share and discuss the latest developments in technology.

## Key Topics

- Y Combinator
- Tech News & Startups
- Programming & Computer Science
- AI & Machine Learning
- RISC-V Architecture
- Apple Silicon
- Community Discussions
- TikTok Trends & Viral Content
- Internet Culture & Memes
- Social Media Platforms (Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook)
- Cyberpunk Literature (Neuromancer, Count Zero)
- HyperCard & Vintage Computing
- Debian & Open Source
- Know Your Meme Documentation

## Core Platform

- [Hacker News](https://news.ycombinator.com): Tech news aggregator homepage featuring Y Combinator community discussions
- [Comment & Login](https://news.ycombinator.com/comment): Login page for commenting and account creation on Hacker News
